title: Shifting a Circle Down and Left
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: The graph of the circle x^2 + y^2 = 49 is to be shifted down 3 units and left 2 units. Give an equation for the shifted graph and describe the original and shifted circles.

steps.title: Apply the Horizontal Shift (Left 2 Units)
steps.explanation: To shift a graph in the xy-plane 2 units to the left, replace x with x + 2 in its equation.
steps.why: Replacing x with x + 2 moves the x-coordinate of the center from 0 to -2.

steps.title: Apply the Vertical Shift (Down 3 Units)
steps.explanation: To shift a graph 3 units downward, replace y with y + 3 in its equation.
steps.why: Replacing y with y + 3 moves the y-coordinate of the center from 0 to -3.

steps.title: Write the Shifted Equation and Compare Geometry
steps.explanation: The original equation x^2 + y^2 = 49 represents a circle of radius 7 centered at (0, 0). The shifted equation (x + 2)^2 + (y + 3)^2 = 49 represents a congruent circle of radius 7 centered at (-2, -3).
steps.why: Rigid translations preserve the radius r = 7 while translating the center from (0, 0) to (-2, -3).
